high_level_description: This image captures a stunning night scene of a large suspension bridge illuminated by numerous lights. The bridge is characterized by its tall, slender towers that rise majestically into the dark sky. The cables connecting the towers to the bridge deck are brightly lit, creating a striking visual effect against the night backdrop. The bridge spans over a body of water, which reflects the lights from the bridge, adding to the overall luminosity of the scene. In the background, there is a cityscape with buildings that are also lit up, suggesting an urban environment.
